evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet transaction rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/init.cpp.
rationale: Decoupling rebroadcasting from initial broadcasting addresses a significant wallet privacy leak where periodic rebroadcasts to all peers identify wallet transactions. The PR description notes that periodic rebroadcasts 'could have bad implications for privacy' by revealing that the node's wallet is related to the transactions, giving users an explicit option to disable them.
